import java.util.Scanner;

public class EmailNormalizer {
    public static String normalizeEmail(Scanner scanner) {
        String emailInput = scanner.next();
        int atLocation = emailInput.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atLocation != -1) {
            emailInput = emailInput.substring(0, atLocation) + "@" + emailInput.substring(atLocation + 2);
        }
        int dotLocation = emailInput.indexOf("dot", 1);
        while (dotLocation != -1 && emailInput.length() != dotLocation + 3) {
            emailInput = emailInput.substring(0, dotLocation) + "." + emailInput.substring(dotLocation + 3);
            dotLocation = emailInput.indexOf("dot", 1);
        }
        return emailInput;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String email = scanner.next();
        System.out.println(normalizeEmail(scanner));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
